title: The Rain Spirit : Code Breaker
summary:
An atmospheric, folk-horror adventure game about uncovering hidden codes in a cursed rain-soaked world. 
A blend of adventure, fantasy and horror. Uncover a huge interactive world filled with codes , clues and puzzles to unlock in different areas.
about:
The Rain Spirit : Code Breaker  

 
// A strange blend of adventure and folk-horror. //

A huge interactive world filled with codes and puzzles to unlock in different areas, discover characters and story mixed with an original score.  



** Headphones recommended.

** Game contains short flashes of light here and there, somewhat minimal. 

** Experimental and odd game play involving codes, maps, dialogue and notes. You may want to try the demo.

Key Features

• 
An open world free to explore, filled with hidden caves, haunted houses, winding paths, strange creatures and clues everywhere—offering hours of discovery.
• 
A world brought to life with professional voice over, 3D audio weather effects, original string/guitar music, and dark storytelling—deeply immersive and atmospheric.
• 
Keyboard, mouse and joystick remapping. 
• 
Save and load anytime, anywhere. Fast load in time, minimal logo screens, straight to the open world. 
• 
Crack codes and locate maps—an ever-expanding variety to keep your mind engaged.
• 
Fun yet terrifying jump scares, hidden in unexpected places. 

With The Rain Spirit: Code Breaker, you don’t just uncover Lila’s world—you step into it, becoming part of a living, breathing mystery that unfolds around you.

Backstory



In the late fall of 1957 , Lila Camarillo , the 11 year old daughter of Javier Camarillo , fell into a lake after a traumatic boating accident caused by a violent rainstorm. While her body and spirit need time for healing, she must reclaim her life by sorting through a vast and mystical alternate reality, for if not, she may never wake again.  



Unable to perceive the real world, Lila is left unknowingly stranded in her own psyche. Her mind desperately trying to cope, forms a vast and mystical wonderland, only to leave her subtle hints of how to get back to reality. She must face many obstacles, paths, portals and puzzles , all which will reflect her outcome. 



She will encounter strange creatures and characters both good and evil , who will assist or detract from her journey. Themes of fear, temptation, illusion, trust and problem solving will test her ability. If lucky enough, she will stumble upon documents, codes, some magic, flashlight, maps and many other items to aide her. If unlucky, she may fall to her death, get bitten, be tricked into danger or encounter the wrong creature. But hidden in some of the finer details, the Rain Spirit is silently waiting. 



Strange clues can be discovered everywhere.



Features



• 
Explore a giant open world, unlocking puzzles and solve codes to further the journey. 
  
• 
Immersive and unique environments blended with sound design, voice over and an original score. 
  
• 
Engage enemies, portals, strange characters and problem solving devices. 
  
• 
An experimental take on the puzzle game genre. 
  
• 
Meet characters to help assist you.
  
• 
Decide or learn whether to trust them or not.
  
• 
Make sure to reference your player log to look up past conversations.
